title: How is Mandela connected to Napoleon?
description: Five photos and two paintings link Nelson Mandela to Napoleon.
hook: How is Mandela connected to Napoleon?

image.file: File:President George W. Bush and Former President Nelson Mandela of South Africa Meet in the Oval Office.jpg

links.line: In 2005, Nelson Mandela visited George W. Bush in the Oval Office.

image.file: File:President George W. Bush, Former President Gerald Ford and Mrs. Betty Ford Greet the Media in Rancho Mirage, California (P042306ED-1123).jpg

links.line: In 2006, Bush dropped in on Gerald Ford at his California home.

image.file: File:Mr. and Mrs. Ford and Nixon 13 Oct 1973.jpg

links.line: Back in 1973, Ford was Richard Nixon's pick for vice president.
In 1970, Nixon hosted Edward VIII, the king who gave up his throne.
In 1894, baby Edward sat on the lap of his great-grandmother, Queen Victoria.

image.file: File:Edward Matthew Ward (1816-79) - Queen Victoria at the Tomb of Napoleon, 24 August 1855 - RCIN 402019 - Royal Collection.jpg

links.line: In 1855, Victoria visited Napoleon's tomb with Napoleon III, as this painting shows.
And in 1810, baby Napoleon III was painted with his uncle, Napoleon.
